description: Create and maintain living per-system design docs at thoughts/*/design-docs/<system-slug>.md — Purpose, Glossary, numbered testable Invariants (normative for the code-reviewing Spec axis), Boundaries & Non-goals, Interfaces, Decision log, Amendment log. Use when the user says "create a design doc", "write down the invariants", "document the design/contract of X", or when researching/planning/one-shot finds a design doc for the touched system and needs the read-and-abide rules.
name: design-docs
title: Design Docs
